raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted a Wikipedia snippet that (likely due to garbled text) listed Rafał Leszczyński and Anna Jabłonowska, treating it as if they were Marie Leszczyńska’s parents. In reality, Marie’s father is Stanisław I Leszczyński (the correct maternal grandfather of Henriette), and the names cited are Stanisław’s parents. This misreading introduced an incorrect alternative and confusion, even though it was later corrected.
